decisions.name: spawn chamber and side alcove
decisions.intent: Preserve source footprint, floor/ceiling transitions, attached supports, eastern windows and direct western alcove. Runtime implementation is LoadingBayRoomRecipe; Engine world Z is negative recipe north. Jamb notches and exact UV/light semantics remain simplified. See ../spawn-layout/README.md.

decisions.name: eastern complex and junctions
decisions.status: implemented adapted zigzag, connector and upper gallery recipes
decisions.intent: LoadingBayEastWingRecipe and LoadingBayEastGalleryRecipe retain the zigzag/lower-basin and upper-overlook roles. The upper floor follows sectors 62/70 at height 3.25; nineteen quarter-unit stairs replace the 152-source-unit moving access. The bent north gallery is adapted to the existing hall; ceiling 5.5 matches the adjoining roof instead of source 5.75. This is not exact source topology or secret/lift gameplay.
